component.name: Vybee
component.summary: Real-time voice, video and text chat platform

description.p: Vybee is a modern real-time communication platform designed for communities, friends, and teams. It features high-quality voice channels with noise suppression, screen sharing with GPU hardware acceleration, rich text messaging, custom emoji reactions, and customizable servers.
Improved Linux GPU hardware acceleration, VA-API/NVDEC decoding and WebRTC PipeWire screen sharing.
